test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Three friends, A, B, and C, are running on a circular track with a circumference of 5 km. They all start from the same point at 8:00 a.m. and travel in the same direction with speeds of 25 km/h, 40 km/h, and 50 km/h respectively. How many times will all three of them meet at the starting point if they continue running until 1:00 p.m.?
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference = 5 km

Start time = 8:00 a.m., End time = 1:00 p.m. (13:00)

Speeds: A = 25 km/h, B = 40 km/h, C = 50 km/h

**Formula used:**

Lap time = Distance ÷ Speed

Simultaneous return time = LCM of individual lap times

Number of meetings = (Total duration ÷ simultaneous return time) + 1 (includes start)

**Calculations:**

⇒ A lap time = 5 ÷ 25 = 0.2 h = 12 min

⇒ B lap time = 5 ÷ 40 = 0.125 h = 7.5 min

⇒ C lap time = 5 ÷ 50 = 0.1 h = 6 min

⇒ In half-min units: A = 24, B = 15, C = 12

⇒ LCM(24,15,12) = 120 half-min units = 60 min = 1 hour

⇒ Total duration = 13:00 − 8:00 = 5 hours = 300 min

⇒ Meetings occur every 60 min ⇒ times: 8:00, 9:00, 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00

⇒ Number of meetings = 300 ÷ 60 + 1 = 5 + 1 = 6

**∴ All three meet at the starting point 6 times (including the start at 8:00 and the end at 13:00).**
